# Icons

256x256 PNG icons referenced by the templates and the `ca_profile.xml` maintainer entry.

**Status: v0.1 placeholders.** Generated by `_make_placeholders.py` using simple two-letter labels on solid colors. Replace with proper icons before any visual polish pass.

The `ca_profile.xml` and every template's `<Icon>` field point at raw GitHub URLs in this directory:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WireSpeedComputing/Unraid-Templates/main/icons/<name>.png
```

| File | Used by |
| --- | --- |
| `wirespeed-computing.png` | `ca_profile.xml` (maintainer icon shown in CA) |
| `mcp-memory.png` | `mcp-memory/mcp-memory.xml`, `mcp-memory/mcp-memory-tailscale.xml` |
| `filesystem-mcp.png` | `filesystem-mcp/filesystem-mcp.xml` |
| `tailscale-sidecar.png` | `tailscale-sidecar/tailscale-sidecar.xml` |

To regenerate placeholders, run:

```
python _make_placeholders.py
```

(Requires Pillow.)

To add a proper icon: produce a 256x256 PNG, name it after the app folder, drop it in this directory, commit.
